# apipbx_inbound_route (Resource)

Sends calls to a DID to a destination. Import with "<tenant id>/<did>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_type` (String) extension, ring_group, voicemail, time_condition, ivr, queue, conference, announcement, misc_destination, set_caller_id, paging_group, voicemail_group, disa or hangup.
- `did` (String) Globally unique, 3-20 digits, optional leading +.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `cid_prefix` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `destination_id` (String) Id of the extension, ring group or voicemail box.
- `language` (String) The language callers of this number hear (an Asterisk sound directory name); empty keeps the trunk's.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
